title: P18.1 Operator Control Center — owner-facing HTTP seams + Mission Control UI over canonical P18 substrate
description: Owner-facing management of the canonical P18 substrate through Mission Control: (1) P18.1-A owner-scoped HTTP seams — objective relations (list/create/advisory-preview/suspend/resume/revoke), org-agent duties (objective/agent/business reads + create + lifecycle), objective transitions (operator-narrowed to PAUSE/RESUME/CANCEL — ACHIEVED stays behind the review-signoff gate), per-objective + business operations observability (driver readiness via the driver's own readiness() proof, P15.10-C convention), canonical integrity probe. Every mutation delegates to ObjectiveRelationService / OrgAgentDutyService / ObjectiveAuthorityService.transitionStatus — zero direct store writes; actor derives only from x-operator-id via canonicalOperatorActor. (2) P18.1-B..F UI: ObjectiveRelations (admission strip + edge list + advisory preview + lifecycle + confirm dialogs + per-op dedup keys replayed on ambiguous failure), AgentDuties (exact-set coverage + lifecycle), CompanyRelations (SVG graph from canonical rows only, edge inspector, revoked toggle), ObjectiveOpsMonitor + operations overview (queue/lease/reasons/NOT_OBSERVED honesty). Foreign-owned preview targets never leak status. IntegrityError is surfaced as UNPROVEN:<code>, never masked as NOT_OBSERVED. (3) docs/e2e-v181/p181-live.mjs — real-browser E2E on the live stack: 39/39 PASS (UI objective create, advisory preview, DEPENDS_ON/SUPERSEDES via UI, UPSTREAM_UNMET live gate, canonical recovery via real CEO pass + review + work-item cancel + sign-off, duty assign/lifecycle via UI, policy disable, ops/integrity panels, UI Inbox sign-off → ACHIEVED, reload persistence, forged-header/cross-business/idempotency adversarial). Audit remediation: transition seam narrowed to PAUSE/RESUME/CANCEL, truthful driver readiness, integrity wedges unmasked, foreign-preview status leak suppressed, agent-existence oracle folded.
